item.title: Owner, Not User
item.description: True digital ownership has always felt like a myth. For the longest time, you couldn’t actually own a piece of the internet. When you pay for web hosting, you’re just renting space on someone else’s server. When you sign up for Gmail, you don’t own that email address—you’re merely a user on an account ultimately controlled by Google. Across almost every platform on the web, you aren’t an owner; you are just a user.
